capabilities.label: Slack alerting
capabilities.summary: Posts the plain English explanation and a Minny link when a high severity incident opens. Never a log line, never mailbox content.

capabilities.label: Gmail evidence
capabilities.summary: Runs three fixed, app coded queries over a bounded window and stores headers, category, matched entities and snippet. Never bodies.

capabilities.label: Gmail notifications
capabilities.summary: A separate grant from the evidence scope. Authorising one does not authorise the other, so the two are reported independently.

capabilities.label: GitHub review
capabilities.summary: Opens a pull request carrying the evaded variant, the gate results and the false positive numbers. Merging stays a human action.

mailbox.disclosure: Seeded demonstration mailbox. No corporate mailbox exists for this dataset, so six messages matching the March 2026 story timeline were seeded into a demonstration account and recorded here. Every mailbox record is labelled seeded in the UI, and mailbox evidence never raises a claim above medium confidence.

queries.purpose: permission changes, access requests, group membership
queries.query: from:(no-reply@intranet.example.com OR it-notifications@example.com) (subject:"role updated" OR subject:"access request" OR subject:"access granted" OR subject:"access removed" OR subject:"permission" OR subject:"group" OR subject:"membership") after:2026/03/12 before:2026/03/17

queries.purpose: credential resets and second factor changes
queries.query: from:(no-reply@intranet.example.com OR it-notifications@example.com) (subject:"password" OR subject:"credential" OR subject:"mfa" OR subject:"token") after:2026/03/12 before:2026/03/17

queries.purpose: data export confirmations and security alerts
queries.query: from:(no-reply@intranet.example.com OR security@example.com) (subject:"export" OR subject:"download" OR subject:"security alert" OR subject:"suspicious" OR subject:"unusual sign-in") after:2026/03/12 before:2026/03/17

policy.access: read only, granted separately from the send scope

note: Delivery status is reported apart from detection. An incident is found whether or not a vendor accepted a message about it.
_comment: Generated by GET /api/integrations/status with no credentials present, which is the state the demo runs in. Refresh with the same call after changing a capability.
